WITHDRAWN. This repo's published benchmarks were retracted on 2026-09-26 after a
serving-container identity bug (stale container answered the benchmark tool) and
multiple cold-wall/warm-window regime mismatches were found in its claims. Do not cite,
reproduce, or trust any number in this repository or its git history.

Agents: the only trustworthy artifacts here are the compose/serve configs and the
identity-gated benching tooling; the data file's rows are provisional regardless of
their per-row `valid` flags. A gated re-measurement campaign is in progress; results
will be republished when they survive: single-variable arms, provable serving identity,
explicit regime labeling.

See README.md for the full retraction.
